create_HabermasMachine: create a HabermasMachine instance to mediate AI-mediated deliberation among participants on a given question
run_HabermasMachine_mediate: run the HabermasMachine mediate method to generate a winning group statement from participant opinions
overwrite_HabermasMachine_previous_winne: overwrite the previous winning statement in the HabermasMachine with a manually specified winner
generate_HabermasMachine_statements: generate candidate group statements from participant opinions using the HabermasMachine statement model
get_HabermasMachine_rankings: get individual citizen rankings over candidate statements using the HabermasMachine reward model
